_readme: Wines the reference table in bot/wine_origin.py cannot place, looked up by hand.
Applied by scripts/enrich_wines.py, which prefers these over the table because an
entry here is a deliberate statement about one specific wine.
In git on purpose: these are public facts about wine regions, unlike the ratings in
data/fcvino.sqlite3. 'source' records where the claim came from so it can be checked.
Match is on the wine's name, accent- and case-insensitive. Every field is optional;
leave one out rather than guessing. Set 'non_wine': true for beer or spirits, which
get a country and never a grape.
